report_date is not a verification date; show verification.last_verified_on separately.
Keep personal applied/saved notes outside this public dataset, keyed by job ID.
Retain dropped roles with reason/evidence rather than deleting history.
Company counts refer to shortlisted openings, not total hiring.
Financial stats require dated sources; distinguish revenue, ARR and valuation.
Schema 1.1.0: archived_jobs permanently retains full last-reported job objects, is_new false, immutable closed_on and evidence-based close_reason.
Use lifecycle_status closed only for confirmed listing removal; unverified for unresolved absence.
A reopened role moves back to jobs with the same id and is removed from archived_jobs; IDs never overlap.
Keep archived-only companies with reported_open_count zero.
Read job-dashboard/chatgpt-instructions.md before future refreshes; LA, SD, other SoCal, SF, elsewhere is the display order.
Keep complete_history false while explicitly documented historical inventory gaps remain.
